name: Outrigger Reef Waikiki Beach
positioning: OUTRIGGER Reef Waikiki Beach Resort: a beachfront hotel on the sands of Waikiki with nightly Hawaiian music and hands-on Hawaiian cultural activities
best_for: Travelers who want a beachfront base in Waikiki with Hawaiian music and culture
Families, with the Coral Kids Club and lessons in hula, lei making and surfing

facts.text: The resort is a beachfront hotel on the sands of Waikiki, at 2169 Kalia Road in Honolulu.
The beach is steps from the hotel, reached by walking toward the back of the building.
Oceanfront rooms have an unobstructed view of the ocean.
Resort view rooms look out toward green mountains.
Club rooms and suites include access to the Voyager 47 Club Lounge.
In the evening, the Voyager 47 Club Lounge serves premium beverages and pupu, Hawaiian appetizers.
Monkeypod Kitchen by Merriman serves farm-fresh cuisine by Chef Peter Merriman, with only glass railings between diners and the ocean a few yards away.
The resort has a swimming pool with poolside cabanas and daybeds.
Honolulu Surf Club Hawaii, on the resort's beachfront, offers beach chaise rentals and surfing lessons.
The resort has a kids club, the Coral Kids Club.
Yoga is offered on Wednesdays and Sundays.
The resort offers a traditional Hawaiian vow renewal ceremony.

highlights.text: Kani Ka Pila Grille, billed as the Home of Hawaiian Music, showcases Hawaiian performers every night.
Hawaiian culture runs through the resort, from curated artwork to Signature Experiences and hands-on crafts.
The Voyager 47 Club Lounge overlooks Waikiki Beach and starts the day with a Hawaiian-style breakfast and premium Kona coffee.
Guests can join lei making and hula lessons, try native island arts and crafts, and learn to play the ukulele.
The lobby is adorned with Polynesian canoe art handpicked by historian Herb Kane.

considerations.text: Voyager 47 Club Lounge access is limited to guests booked in a club room or suite.
Pet-friendly rooms are available, but carry a fee.
WhataHotel notes a busy tourist area with crowded beach access.
